original_test_intent: Validate every SMBIOS Type 43 TPM Device field against the security-approved TPM identity/version/firmware/characteristics matrix and prove persistence after reboot without modifying trust state.
original_method: Preserve security logs, collect complete raw and decoded Type 43 plus approved read-only OS/measured-boot context on the verified SUT, compare all fields, perform one authorized reboot, repeat and audit that no TPM or BIOS-security mutation occurred.
manual_activity: The security owner supplies Type 43 expectations/redaction and approves reboot/recovery; an operator supervises workload and measured-boot impact while all collection stays read-only.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/TPM identity, BIOS/SMBIOS, TPM firmware and dmidecode versions
Expected TPM Vendor ID, spec major/minor, Firmware Version 1/2, description, characteristics and OEM values
TPM absent/disabled/multiple-device policy and security-owner interpretation
Protected raw custody and redaction rules for TPM identifiers and boot measurements
Approved read-only OS TPM/measured-boot corroboration commands
Approved reboot, boot deadline, workload impact and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Never clear, provision, take ownership of, reset, initialize, update or otherwise mutate the TPM
Never extend PCRs or change BIOS Secure Boot/TPM/security settings
Preserve all pre-existing security, TPM, kernel, SEL and boot logs
Use protected credentials and verified host identity; redact only controlled review copies
Require reboot approval and stop on identity drift, sensitive-data exposure or recovery failure
No automatic retry after a boot or trust-state anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Verify security-owner matrix, target and approved evidence/reboot plan
Collect full read-only Type 43 and optional approved TPM visibility/measurement context
Compare every field and same-target pre/post persistence
Audit commands and state for absence of TPM/BIOS/log mutation
Make no trust-state operation, disclosure, retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Approve TPM identity/version/characteristic/absent semantics and evidence policy
Review any identity/firmware/characteristic/persistence anomaly and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 43` is relevant, but `grep -A1` omits all required fields, no reboot comparison exists and insecure SSH handling is unacceptable for security evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture complete raw/decoded `dmidecode -t 43` and only approved read-only TPM context before/after one authorized reboot; issue no TPM or BIOS-security command that changes state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All eight Type 43 field groups, reboot persistence, source script and 5/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Hash protected raw captures, parse every Type 43 device field, correlate only non-mutating OS TPM identity where approved, compare the owner matrix across reboot and record a complete no-security-state-change audit.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete field/security governance and removes filtered, insecure and destructive log handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A TPM Device heading or `/dev/tpm` presence cannot prove correct vendor encoding, spec/firmware versions, characteristics or Type 43 persistence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS metadata and OS visibility do not validate cryptographic health or attestation. Those operations are separate and must not be inferred or invoked here.

project_override_considerations: Allowed TPM firmware/version transitions, disabled states or OEM fields require an exact security-approved recipe revision; no override can authorize implicit TPM clear/provisioning within this metadata case.
expected_evidence: Verified SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS/TPM/dmidecode identity and approved Type 43 matrix
Complete protected pre-reboot raw/decoded fields and approved read-only TPM context
Approved reboot/boot/measured-boot timeline and same-target proof
Complete post-reboot Type 43 diff and security-log context
No TPM/PCR/BIOS-security/log mutation, secure-access/no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target Type 43 field correctness and reboot persistence. DeepSeek is incomplete but does not create a different intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Security-owner inputs and reboot approval gate execution but do not prevent full static review.

review_improvement: Preserves every TPM metadata field and adds protected evidence, measured-boot awareness and a strict trust-state no-mutation boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: TPM metadata review must not become TPM functional administration: provisioning, PCR extension or clearing changes exactly the trust evidence later reviewers may need. SMBIOS Type 43 can be validated entirely read-only from complete structures, with OS visibility used only as corroboration. Firmware/version persistence must be tied to the same physical TPM and SUT because cross-host output could look plausible while invalidating the security conclusion.
